author: ZeeDeveel
text: Hey Gembel, you got any tips regarding which news announcements to look out for? I use FF calendar but most of the red ones are non-events. It seems ECB, Fed, NFP are huge.. Anything else? Things like FOMC definitely need to be paid respect.
